entries.title: Unusual Sea Creatures of Byalan
entries.text: Adventurers and sailors at Izlude speak of bizarre marine life and walking starfish lurking in the sunken caves beneath Byalan Island.
entries.source_location: Izlude Sailor by the ferry dock

entries.title: Morroc Merchant Ant Jaw Demand
entries.text: Desert merchants gathering near Morroc are offering high bounties for sturdy Ant Jaws gathered from the subterranean chambers of Ant Hell.

entries.title: Payon Cave Whispering Depths
entries.text: Villagers in Payon warn young travelers that mournful whispers echo from the deeper subterranean levels of Payon Cave where the restless dead wander.

entries.title: Geffen Tower Magical Metals
entries.text: Wizards atop the Geffen Tower study the alchemical properties of Oridecon and Phracon, claiming pure minerals amplify enchanted bladecraft.

entries.title: Sunken Ship of Treasure Island
entries.text: Seasoned sailors along the Alberta docks trade rumors of an eerie ghost ship stranded off the coast of Alberta, filled with cursed chests and undead buccaneers.

entries.title: Prontera Culvert Infestation
entries.text: The Prontera City Guard recruits novice adventurers to clear the sewer network west of the capital, reporting aggressive thief bugs and oversized vermin.

entries.title: Ancient Ruins of Glast Heim
entries.text: Scholars whisper of a fallen kingdom northwest of Geffen known as Glast Heim, where crumbling battlements and forgotten archives guard long-lost relics.

entries.title: Trans-Continental Flying Airship
entries.text: Engineers from Schwarzwald and Midgarts maintain regular international airship flights departing from the Izlude and Yuno air terminals.
